pillars.label: Social
pillars.description: Tracking education, healthcare, housing, and community development programs across the nation.

objectives.title: Reduce Child Poverty Rate to 10%
objectives.description: Expand SNAP, EITC, and child tax credit programs to lift 3.5 million children out of poverty by 2026.

objectives.title: Universal Pre-K Enrollment
objectives.description: Achieve 90% enrollment rate for 3–4 year olds in quality pre-kindergarten programs nationwide.

objectives.title: Reduce Veteran Homelessness by 25%
objectives.description: Expand HUD-VASH vouchers and supportive services to permanently house 38,000 veterans.

policies.title: Affordable Care Act Marketplace Expansion
policies.description: Enhanced premium tax credits extended through 2025, covering 21 million Americans on ACA marketplaces.

policies.title: Student Loan Income-Driven Repayment (SAVE Plan)
policies.description: SAVE plan caps payments at 5% of discretionary income for undergraduate loans; currently under legal review.

policies.title: SNAP Modernization & Benefit Adequacy
policies.description: Updated Thrifty Food Plan increases average SNAP benefit by 21%, reaching 42 million participants.

projects.title: Community Health Centers Expansion
projects.description: Expanding 1,400 federally qualified health centers to serve an additional 6 million patients in underserved areas.

projects.title: National Affordable Housing Trust Fund
projects.description: Construction and rehabilitation of 60,000 affordable rental units for extremely low-income households.

projects.title: Broadband Equity Access & Deployment (BEAD)
projects.description: Deploy high-speed internet to every unserved and underserved location in the US by 2030.

projects.title: Head Start Program Expansion
projects.description: Serving 833,000 children ages 0–5 with comprehensive early childhood education and family support services.

pillars.label: Political
pillars.description: Tracking government modernization, election security, federal transparency, and institutional reform initiatives.

objectives.title: Modernize Federal Procurement Systems
objectives.description: Streamline federal acquisition processes to reduce contract award timelines by 30% and increase small business participation.

objectives.title: Strengthen Election Infrastructure Security
objectives.description: Harden election infrastructure against cyber threats in all 50 states through grants, audits, and technical assistance.

objectives.title: Federal Workforce Diversity & Inclusion Goals
objectives.description: Achieve representative workforce demographics across all GS pay grades by 2027 per EO 14035.

policies.title: Bipartisan Infrastructure Law Implementation
policies.description: Coordinating 375+ federal programs across 20 agencies to deliver roads, bridges, broadband, water, and transit investments.

policies.title: FOIA Modernization & Transparency Initiative
policies.description: Reduce FOIA backlog by 50% and launch proactive disclosure portals across all major federal agencies.

policies.title: Lobbying Disclosure & Ethics Reform
policies.description: Expand real-time lobbying disclosure requirements and close revolving-door loopholes for senior officials.

projects.title: USASpending.gov Data Quality Improvement
projects.description: Achieved 99.2% data accuracy across $6.8T in federal spending records, enabling real-time public transparency.

projects.title: Federal Agency Performance.gov Refresh
projects.description: Redesign Performance.gov to surface agency priority goals, progress indicators, and learning agendas in real time.

projects.title: State & Local Government Cybersecurity Grant Program
projects.description: Distributing $1B in cybersecurity grants to state, local, tribal, and territorial governments through 2025.

pillars.label: Economic
pillars.description: Measuring GDP growth, employment initiatives, trade policy, and infrastructure investment outcomes.

objectives.title: Achieve 4% Annual GDP Growth
objectives.description: Sustain 4%+ real GDP growth through investment in clean energy, manufacturing, and workforce development.

objectives.title: Reduce Unemployment to 3.5%
objectives.description: Unemployment reached 3.4% in January 2023 — lowest since 1969. Sustained below 4% through targeted workforce programs.

objectives.title: Onshore 50 Critical Supply Chains
objectives.description: Rebuild domestic manufacturing capacity in semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, EVs, and critical minerals.

policies.title: Inflation Reduction Act — Clean Energy Tax Credits
policies.description: Production and investment tax credits driving $3T+ in private clean energy investment commitments through 2030.

policies.title: CHIPS & Science Act Semiconductor Investment
policies.description: Funding domestic semiconductor fabrication, R&D, and workforce development to reduce reliance on foreign chip supply.

policies.title: Small Business Administration Lending Expansion
policies.description: SBA 7(a) and 504 loan programs approved $43B in small business financing in FY2024, a record high.

projects.title: National EV Charging Network
projects.agency: FHWA / Joint Office of Energy & Transportation
projects.description: Deploy 500,000 EV chargers along US highways and in communities by 2030 under the BIL.

projects.title: Appalachian Regional Commission Economic Development
projects.description: Investing in workforce training, broadband, and business development across 423 Appalachian counties.

projects.title: Hydrogen Hub Development Program
projects.description: Funding 7 regional clean hydrogen hubs to produce, store, and distribute clean hydrogen at scale.

projects.title: Manufacturing USA Network Expansion
projects.description: 17 Manufacturing USA institutes advancing applied R&D in advanced manufacturing technologies.
